name: officedex
description: The AI desktop workspace for documents, slides, and spreadsheets. Wails v2 + React 19 client for OfficeCLI.

scripts.bundle:licenses:mac: node scripts/bundle-licenses.mjs --target build/bin/OfficeDex.app && node scripts/verify-bundled-fonts.mjs build/bin/OfficeDex.app
scripts.bundle:licenses:win: node scripts/bundle-licenses.mjs --target build/bin && node scripts/verify-bundled-fonts.mjs build/bin
scripts.build: wails build -ldflags "-X main.appVersion=$(node -p 'require(`./package.json`).version')" && npm run bundle:office2modoc:mac && npm run bundle:officecli:mac
scripts.build:desktop: npm run prefetch:officecli && npm run build:frontend:desktop && wails build -s -ldflags "-X main.appVersion=$(node -p 'require(`./package.json`).version')" && npm run bundle:office2modoc:mac && npm run bundle:officecli:mac
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prefetch:officecli && npm run prefetch:word2mow && npm run stage:mop-runtime && npm run stage:presentation && npm run stage:writer-fonts && wails build -ldflags "-X main.appVersion=$(node -p 'require(`./package.json`).version')" && node scripts/bundle-runtime.mjs && node scripts/verify-packaged-runtime.mjs build/bin && npm run bundle:office2modoc:mac && npm run bundle:officecli:mac && node scripts/notarize.mjs build/bin/OfficeDex.app
scripts.dist:win: npm run prefetch:officecli && npm run prefetch:word2mow && npm run stage:mop-runtime && npm run stage:presentation && npm run stage:writer-fonts && wails build -platform windows/amd64 -ldflags "-X main.appVersion=$(node -p 'require(`./package.json`).version')" && node scripts/bundle-runtime.mjs && node scripts/verify-packaged-runtime.mjs build/bin && npm run bundle:licenses:win
scripts.test:scripts: node scripts/verify-presentation-source.mjs && node scripts/verify-bridge-types.mjs && node --test scripts/entry-choice.test.mjs scripts/sync-writer-component.hostRuntime.test.mjs scripts/bundle-office2modoc.test.mjs scripts/bundle-runtime.test.mjs scripts/codesign-bundled-officecli.test.mjs scripts/sdk-sheet-build-assets.test.mjs scripts/stage-presentation-runtime.test.mjs scripts/sync-presentation-component.test.mjs scripts/sync-writer-component.test.mjs scripts/writer-embed-cache.test.mjs scripts/stage-writer-fonts.test.mjs scripts/prefetch-word2mow-convert.test.mjs scripts/verify-font-licenses.test.mjs scripts/verify-bundled-fonts.test.mjs scripts/verify-officecli-canvas-contract.test.mjs scripts/relocatable-runtime.test.mjs scripts/verify-packaged-runtime.test.mjs scripts/verify-release-version.test.mjs scripts/update-channel.test.mjs scripts/build-manifest.test.mjs scripts/publish-update-channel.test.mjs scripts/verify-mop-schema.test.mjs
scripts.test:go: env -u GOROOT go test ./... -count=1 && env -u GOROOT go test -tags officedex_demo ./... -count=1
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run test:scripts && npx vitest run && npm run test:go && npm run test:e2e
